reserveReview.rationale: Composition follows the Accountable attested asset-distribution table as of 2026-08-05 (total reserves $55.48M vs $55.21M supply, 100.5% collateral ratio): money markets 60.93%, delta-neutral futures arbitrage 27.52%, cash and equivalents held as FX collateral 10.25%, on-chain buffer 1.3%. Accountable independently verifies liabilities from the trUSD contract and asset values from custodian and venue data connectors on a 15-minute cadence using Merkle-root, enclave, and zero-knowledge proofs. Because the strategy-level percentages are independently attested and sum to the reported reserve total, the reserve split is treated as verified; the undisclosed custodian/venue identities and unpublished reserve-fund size are captured as risk factors and in the coin notice rather than as unknown reserve exposure.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Accountable attested asset-distribution and custody tables dated 2026-08-05; Tori strategy and institutional docs; verified ToriMinting contract source and independent on-chain flow tracing of the custodian wallet.
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Custodian bank, investment-bank, and execution-venue identities are undisclosed by policy, venue-level allocations and leverage are unpublished, and the size of the protocol reserve fund is undisclosed; the attested split cannot be independently reconciled against the on-chain flows, which terminate at exchange deposit addresses and an unlabeled wallet. These gaps affect custody/counterparty risk assessment, not the verified strategy-level composition split.
